skill.name: industry-key-contact-radar-api-skill
skill.description: Discover public professional profiles for selected industries, roles, and target sites using the BrowserAct API. The skill runs a BrowserAct workflow, monitors task status, and returns profile links with names, introductions, and companies when available.
skill.summary: Find public industry contacts through a BrowserAct workflow.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs its documented BrowserAct workflow, and most static findings are benign Markdown formatting or normal API-key handling. Confirmed risks include outbound requests to BrowserAct, local script execution, instructions that can lead users to paste an API key into chat, and automated contact harvesting for outreach. No evidence of prompt injection, persistence, or local system reconnaissance was found.

remediation.issue: The skill asks users to provide BROWSERACT_API_KEY in chat when the environment variable is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to configure the key through an environment variable or secret manager, and remove chat-based key collection instructions.

remediation.issue: The skill automates collection of public profile data for lead generation and outreach.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear compliance guidance for consent, privacy law obligations, platform terms, and acceptable use before running searches.

remediation.issue: The skill runs a local Python command with user-selected search parameters.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to pass arguments as an argument list or safely quoted values, and avoid shell interpolation of user-provided input.

remediation.issue: The skill sends search parameters and an authorization header to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact external endpoint and data sent so users can make an informed network-use decision.

content.value_statement: Finding relevant public professional profiles across platforms can take hours. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow that returns profile links, names, introductions, and company details.
actual_capabilities: Runs a local Python script with industry, result limit, target site, and job title inputs.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY to start a BrowserAct workflow template.
Polls BrowserAct task status until completion, failure, cancellation, or timeout.
Retrieves workflow output and prints available profile links, names, introductions, and companies.
Reports invalid authorization and concurrent task limit errors with next steps.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and network access.
Results depend on BrowserAct workflow availability and target site responses.
Does not verify identities, employment status, or profile completeness.
Users must ensure collection complies with laws and platform terms.

use_cases.description: Find public founder or executive profiles for a defined industry and platform.

use_cases.title: Source role-based candidates
use_cases.description: Search for public profiles that match a target role, industry, and site.

use_cases.title: Map public market contacts
use_cases.description: Collect public profile links and company context for market research.

prompt_templates.title: Find founders
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for one industry and site.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find 10 founder profiles in the healthcare industry on LinkedIn using my configured BrowserAct API key.

prompt_templates.title: Search a target role
prompt_templates.prompt: Search GitHub for developer relations leaders in browser automation and summarize the names, profile links, and companies.

prompt_templates.title: Limit and structure results
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced search with clear output constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a limited contact discovery for marketing managers in ecommerce on LinkedIn. Return public profile links, names, introductions, and companies.

prompt_templates.title: Compare platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare public founder profile results for fintech across LinkedIn and GitHub. Use a limit of 10 per platform and summarize overlap and gaps.

output_examples.input: Find founder profiles for browser automation on LinkedIn.
output_examples.output: A concise list of public profile links with names, company names, and short introductions when BrowserAct returns them.

output_examples.input: Search for marketing managers in ecommerce on Facebook.
output_examples.output: A results summary grouped by returned contact, including available profile URL, name, introduction, and company context.

output_examples.input: Find developer relations leaders in open source tooling on GitHub.
output_examples.output: A public profile shortlist with available names, links, organization details, and notes about missing fields.

best_practices: Use a small result limit for the first run to confirm quality.
Store the BrowserAct API key in an environment variable, not in chat.
Review results for compliance before outreach or enrichment.
anti_patterns: Do not ask users to paste API keys into a conversation.
Do not use the skill to bypass platform access rules or consent requirements.
Do not treat returned public profiles as verified contact records.

faq.question: What does this skill search for?
faq.answer: It searches for public professional profiles that match an industry, site, and job title.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be configured before the script can run.

faq.question: Which sites can I target?
faq.answer: The skill accepts a target site parameter, such as LinkedIn, Facebook, or GitHub.

faq.question: What fields can it return?
faq.answer: It can return profile URLs, names, introductions, and company details when the workflow provides them.

faq.question: Does it verify the contacts?
faq.answer: No. Users should validate identities, roles, and company associations before use.

faq.question: Can it be used for outreach lists?
faq.answer: It can support research, but users must follow privacy laws, consent rules, and platform terms.
